# Can Legal and Professional Personnel Selection Principles be Met With Machine Learning (Artificial Intelligence)?

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Michael A. Campion  
**Year:** 2026  
**Journal:** Human Resource Management  
**DOI:** [10.1002/hrm.70025](https://doi.org/10.1002/hrm.70025)

**Keywords:** machine learning, AI, personnel selection, hiring, legal compliance, professional standards, algorithmic fairness

## Abstract

Evaluates whether machine learning (a form of AI) can meet scientific, professional, and legal standards for personnel selection, examining issues of validity, fairness, adverse impact, and regulatory compliance in algorithmic hiring.
